# Working in this repo with navi-delivery

This file is generated from the agent and skill tree so any harness — with
or without plugin support — can pick up the framework from a single paste.
Before producing any artefact, adopt the phase's agent below and load the
skills it lists. If a listed capability is not native here, use its
fallback instead.

## Capability fallbacks

| Capability | claude_code | codex | cursor | Fallback when unavailable |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `read_file` | Read | file read | file read | ask the human to paste the file |
| `write_file` | Write | file write | file write | emit the file in a fenced block |
| `run_command` | Bash | shell | shell | ask the human to run it and paste output |
| `search` | Grep/Glob | search | search | ask for the relevant paths |
| `ask_human` | AskUserQuestion | prompt | prompt | ask a plain question, then wait |
| `spawn_subagent` | Agent | — | — | adopt the persona sequentially in this session |

### navi-agent-architect (architecture)

Use when choosing the technical approach for a change — its boundaries, its quality attributes, its failure modes, and what we are buying versus building — and when reviewing whether what was built matches what was decided. Owns ADLC Phases 3 and 9 and the G3-DESIGN gate.

- Owns gates: G3, G9
